subject: refactor riscv-v implementation.
perf_evidence: Same PR as 87b712a ('enhance riscv-v implementation performance'): scrambleAcc_rvv replaces the emulated 64x32 multiply (two vmul_vv on even/odd 32-bit halves + shift + add) with a single vmul_vx by PRIME32_1, and initCustomSecret_rvv uses strided loads/stores instead of a materialised seed array; fewer instructions.
change_summary: XXH3_scrambleAcc_rvv: loop index steps by vl elements; acc*=PRIME32_1 via one vmul_vx_u64m2. XXH3_initCustomSecret_rvv: vlse64/vsse64 with stride 16 over (lo,hi) 8-byte pairs, lo+=seed, hi-=seed. accumulate_512_rvv unchanged.

units.name: XXH3_scrambleAcc_rvv
units.evidence: Alive2: 'ERROR: Unsupported type: <vscale x 2 x i64>' / 'Unsupported instruction: call <vscale x 2 x i64> @llvm.riscv.vle.nxv2i64.i64(...)' -> 'Could not translate'

units.evidence: Alive2: 'ERROR: Unsupported type: <vscale x 2 x i64>' / 'Unsupported instruction: call <vscale x 2 x i64> @llvm.riscv.vle.nxv2i64.i64(...)' -> 'Could not translate'

units.evidence: Alive2 cannot translate scalable-vector RVV intrinsics (target_api_len1024)

notes: x86-64 IR unchanged: wrapper with all one-shot APIs (XXH32/XXH64/XXH3_64 seed+secret/XXH3_128, symbolic len) compiled with -march=x86-64-v3 and with default SSE2 gives identical modules except !srcloc line metadata (x86_ident_v3/, x86_ident_sse2/); riscv64 -march=rv64gc (no V) also identical target IR (ident_rv64gc_novector/). RVV intrinsics compile to scalable-vector LLVM types (<vscale x N x i64>) and llvm.riscv.* calls, which Alive2 cannot translate at all; even with -march=rv64gcv_zvl512b -mrvv-vector-bits=zvl the IR keeps scalable types (vscale_range(8,8)), see 2973489/compile_rvv_zvl512/. Inputs are value args (U8ARGS) copied into local arrays; XXH3_accumulate_512/XXH3_scrambleAcc/XXH3_initCustomSecret are the library's own dispatch macros. Flags: --target riscv64-linux-gnu, cflags '-O3 -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -w -nostdlibinc -isystem _work2020/cross_sysinc -march=rv64gcv' + '-DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000' (no -ffreestanding so memcpy stays a builtin). Sanity: target_acc512 IR identical old/new (accumulate unchanged by this commit). Not checkable: whether vmul_vx(acc, PRIME32_1) equals the old even/odd emulation (it should: (lo*P) + ((hi*P)<<32) == acc*P mod 2^64), and the strided initCustomSecret rewrite. Old and new both = parent 1a08a8e vs this commit (sibling of 87b712a in the same PR).
